subject: GlacierPay invoice question: large May consumption delta and token attribution
messages:
From: Samantha Li <sam@glacierpay.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, accounts@glacierpay.com
Date: Sat, 05 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected May consumption spike / request for breakdown

Hi Kimberly,

Hope you're well. Our finance team just received the May invoice and there's a ~72% increase in billed tokens compared to April (line item: streaming generation). We reviewed our internal usage and don't see a corresponding increase in traffic. Attached is our export of daily client usage (glacierpay_usage_202705.csv).

Can you: 1) provide a per-day, per-route token attribution for our account (including which model variants were used), 2) explain any metering changes or sampling/windowing adjustments on Redwood's side in May, and 3) confirm whether any retries or replay ingestion could have caused duplicate counts?

We need this detail to reconcile with our month-end close and to confirm whether we'll be able to approve the invoice. Also include an estimate of potential credit if an overcount is found.

Thanks,
Samantha Li
Finance Ops | GlacierPay
S: +1 415-555-0192
[Attachment: glacierpay_usage_202705.csv]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Li <sam@glacierpay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected May consumption spike / request for breakdown

Hi Samantha — thanks for the heads up and for sending the CSV. I've looped in Ben (billing) and Connor (CS) to pull our metering traces and tokenization logs.

Ben — can you start with a per-day export for May broken down by route and model variant? Also, please check for ingestion/replay patterns and whether any sampling window change hit on 2027-05-14 (we rolled a minor tagging change that week). Connor, please flag any support tickets from GlacierPay that might show retries.

Samantha — we'll aim to get an initial findings summary and suggested credit estimate by Monday morning PST. If you have specific request IDs or run_ids from your side, please paste them here (helps correlate).

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
[Attachment: request_sample_logs.txt]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Li <sam@glacierpay.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 06 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected May consumption spike / request for breakdown

Samantha / Kimberly — quick update with preliminary findings from our metering audit. Attaching the detailed token-audit PDF and a small sample of telemetry logs for 2027-05-13 through 2027-05-16.

Summary of what we found (short):
- On 2027-05-14 at ~03:10 UTC we deployed a lightweight metadata-tagging change that altered how request prefixes were normalized for a small subset of routes used by GlacierPay. That change inadvertently caused two routing keys to be treated as distinct for ~18 hours, which produced duplicate prefix-kv cache resets for a subset of streaming sessions.
- The net effect was that ~1.9M tokens were double-counted across 2027-05-14 and 2027-05-15 for your account. The root cause is in our prefix normalization patch (no change to tokenization algorithm itself).
- We do not see any evidence of replayed requests or customer-side retries triggering the duplicate counts. Your request IDs appear unique.

Proposed remediation:
- We propose a goodwill credit equivalent to the duplicated tokens (1,900,000 tokens) at your current per-token rate: preliminary credit estimate = $1,240.
- Additionally, as a one-time operational credit for the lift on your team, we propose $500 credit to be applied to the next invoice.
- We'll provide a corrected invoice (proforma) and a short audit package you can share with GlacierPay finance and procurement.

Attachments: token_audit_202705.pdf (detailed per-route breakdown), sample-telemetry-logs-202705.zip (sampled telemetry, request-id mapping).

Next steps: Kimberly, please confirm GlacierPay is ok with the proposed credits and whether the accounts team needs a PO update or VAT-specific wording on the credit memo. If approved, we'll issue a corrected invoice and attach the audit PDF for your records.

Thanks — apologies for the hassle. We're scheduling an internal retro to tighten the rollout checks that missed the prefix normalization edge.

Best,
Ben Carter
Billing Operations Lead | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
[Attachments: token_audit_202705.pdf, sample-telemetry-logs-202705.zip]

From: Samantha Li <sam@glacierpay.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts@glacierpay.com
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected May consumption spike / request for breakdown

Thanks for the quick investigation and the proposed remediation. We appreciate the thorough audit.

A few items from Finance/Accounts payable:
- GlacierPay accepts the credit for the duplicated tokens, and we appreciate the $500 operational credit. Please issue a corrected proforma invoice showing: original invoice number, credit line item(s) with VAT treatment indicated, and a short explanation ("duplicate metering due to prefix normalization issue; credit applied").
- Our AP team needs the credit memo to reference our PO # GP-1902 and to indicate whether the credit will be netted on June payment or if you'd prefer to apply it to next cycle. We prefer netting on the June payment if possible.
- VAT: the credit memo needs to include VAT reversal wording for our Belgian entity; please confirm you can include the VAT reverse-charge reference (GlacierPay VAT BE0123456789) or provide a zeroed VAT line and separate VAT statement — our tax team will confirm.
- Please confirm that applying this credit will not change any billing-tier commitments or SLAs for GlacierPay.

Cc'ing accounts@glacierpay.com so they have the audit PDF. Once we have the corrected invoice and credit memo, we'll process the payment.

Thanks again — Samantha Li
Finance Ops | GlacierPay
